institution.provenance: DRAFT decision-support protocol authored from standard-of-care knowledge (NCCN/DeVita/Harrison, general reference); experimental, not clinically activated

name: Intrathecal triple chemotherapy (CNS prophylaxis)

premedications.name: Platelet check
premedications.notes: confirm platelets adequate for safe lumbar puncture before each dose

supportiveCare: Deliver by lumbar puncture (or Ommaya) by a trained operator
Patient lies flat after the procedure per local practice
monitoring: CSF cytology/flow at the first tap to exclude occult CNS involvement
Number of doses individualized to CNS-relapse risk

drugs.name: Methotrexate (intrathecal)
drugs.notes: 12 mg intrathecal, per dose. Age-adjusted; preservative-free only.
